At Space Coast Credit Union (SCCU), our members are at the heart of everything we do. Since 1951, we’ve been committed to delivering financial services founded on integrity and a people-first philosophy.

As a Mortgage Loan Processor in our Melbourne Headquarters, you’ll help guide approved first mortgage loans from application through closing. You’ll review loan files for completeness and accuracy, coordinate required documentation, support borrowers and business partners, and help ensure timely, compliant closings that exceed member expectations.

Why Join SCCU?

  • Member-Focused Mission: Be part of a not-for-profit organization that reinvests in its members.
  • Hybrid and Flexible Schedule Options: Able to work from home up to 3 days a week. 2 days in office required.   
  • Career Growth: We prioritize internal promotions and offer on-the-job training.

 Mortgage Loan Processor Key Responsibilities

  • Review and process conventional, FHA, VA, and other first mortgage loan applications for completeness, accuracy, and compliance with lending guidelines.
  • Verify borrower income, assets, employment, credit history, and funds to close; ensure approval conditions are satisfied before closing.
  • Order and review appraisals, title commitments, flood certifications, and other third-party documentation within established timelines.
  • Submit complete loan files to underwriting, follow up promptly on conditions, and manage a pipeline of approximately 20–40 loans in line with department goals.
  • Communicate clearly with borrowers, Realtors, closing agents, and internal partners regarding documentation, file status, and closing arrangements while maintaining confidentiality.
  • Resolve member questions and file issues efficiently while meeting established productivity, loan quality, regulatory, attendance, and service standards.

Mortgage Loan Processor Requirements

  • Two-year degree or equivalent experience required.
  • 3–5 years of mortgage processing, mortgage closing, or banking experience related to review and process of mortgage applications required.
    • Mortgage closing or mortgage processing experience preferred.
  • Familiarity with TRID and investor guidelines, including Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, FHA, and VA, preferred.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain active NMLS registration before performing mortgage loan originator activities, when applicable.

As a Process Engineer III, you will supports the continued growth and development of SCCU. The Business Process Engineer will collaborate with stakeholders throughout the enterprise to craft process improvements, optimizations, and automations that deliver improved business performance as well as improved learner and Team Member experience. The Business Process Engineer will serve as a change champion, driving adoption of Lean Six Sigma, identifying and implementing transformational operating models, and creating better connections between our people, processes, and technologies. The Business Process Engineer will lead group initiatives that encompass research and future state requiring application of specialized knowledge or skills critical to the design and redesign of SSCU business processes.

Why Join SCCU?

  • Member-Focused Mission: Be part of a not-for-profit organization that reinvests in its members.
  • Flexible Schedule Options
  • Career Growth: We prioritize internal promotions and offer on-the-job training.

Process Engineer III Key Responsibilities

  • Execute end to end process improvement efforts by using Six Sigma/LEAN methodology and Business Process Modeling to conduct current state process analysis, build future state vision and formulate actionable improvement opportunities by partnering with cross-functional teams.
  • Integrate effective change management and training techniques to drive enhanced standardization and alignment across SCCU.
  • Analyzing and interpreting data using statistical techniques to support re-engineering objectives
    Designing and building future state processes and tools to enable scalable and flexible operations by creating new processes or improve existing flow across functional teams making it clearly documented and actionable.
  • Utilizes key Lean Six Sigma and Operational Excellence principles to identify opportunities, define and justify projects, launch project teams, manage team activities, track project status, measure results, remove project barriers and develop/train team members.
  • Motivates and directs cross functional teams in applying Lean Six Sigma and continuous improvement methodologies, planning and implementing product and process improvement activities. Documents key work streams and processes with the appropriate maps, policies, procedures, work instructions, etc. Gains are sustained and replicated across the business. Supports business personnel activities to eliminate ‘waste’, reduce costs and increase throughput to enable growth.
  • Improves internal and external member experience by building continuous improvement foundation on which SCCU’s businesses can perform and grow.
  • Increases team member awareness of processes and tools to deliver better products, services, and experiences for our customers. Drives Lean Six Sigma principles, tools and applications throughout company creating a culture that shares best practices and learns from mistakes.
  • Works with management to identify challenge areas and key gaps within organization for process improvement/ waste reduction projects thus building a robust pipeline. Continually challenges the status quo in support of Growth Initiatives.
  • Establish standards for measuring performance against process requirements utilizing formal process engineering tools and methods
  • Ensure development of metrics that provide data for future improvement opportunities
  • Strong product knowledge and a good grasp with an understanding of member expectations and quality of products.

Process Engineer III Requirements

  • Bachelors Degree preferably in a Business or Technical discipline and Lean/Six Sigma Black Belt (DMAIC, DFSS or equivalent) required. Professional certifications such as Business Process Professional (CBPP) and Change Management Professional (CMP) preferred.
  • 8-10 years of Process Engineering experience required, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education.

As the Express Service Associate at our Miramar Operations Center, you will promote SCCU’s financial products by converting incoming and outbound calls from new and existing members into closed sales by providing outstanding service, product and service information, addressing concerns and guiding members to the right fit product.

Why Join SCCU?

  • Member-Focused Mission: Be part of a not-for-profit organization that reinvests in its members.

Express Service Associate Key Responsibilities

  • Handle outgoing and incoming member phone calls, conduct loan interviews, assesses member needs, and cross sells other SCCU products and services. Provide fast, friendly, effective service to the members.
  • Opens new memberships and looks for opportunities to add-on deposit products for existing members to ensure the retention and profitability of members.      
  • Analyzes loan applications, credit bureau reports and member account data to match the member to the appropriate product or service and maximize loan and add-on.
  • Enters the loan or new account application in the loan origination system in accordance with required data entry procedures to meet established quality standards. Monitors pipeline to follow up on pending applications, collects required documentation, and keeps members informed throughout the loan/account process.
  • Meets established productivity standards to ensure efficiency.
  • Participates in regular product, system, and compliance training to maintain knowledge of changes in policies, procedures, and product offerings.

Express Service Associate Requirements

  • Minimum 1 to 3 years prior experience in sales and customer service or consumer loan processing/interviewing. Telephone sales preferred. 

  • High School plus additional course work gained through attendance at vocational, technical or business school or equivalent experience.
  • This position requires federal registration with the Nationwide Multistate Licensing System and Registry (NMLS) if the Team Member performs mortgage loan originator activities, including taking residential mortgage loan applications or offering/negotiating residential mortgage loan terms. The Team Member must obtain and maintain active NMLS registration and a unique identifier before performing MLO activities. Continued eligibility to perform MLO duties is subject to satisfactory completion of applicable NMLS registration requirements, including required background check review, fingerprinting, renewal, and ongoing compliance obligations. Failure to obtain or maintain required NMLS registration may result in removal from MLO duties and may lead to further employment action, consistent with SCCU policy and applicable law.
  • You must have the ability to obtain CUNA Mutual licensing within the first eight weeks of initial employment. The CUNA Mutual License is required for this position.
  • Bilingual English/Spanish fluency required.
